entities.name: Boc hydrazino heteroarene
observations: Contains a free exocyclic amino group and a Boc-protected hydrazine.
The free exocyclic amino group is the proposed acylation site.

entities.name: Cyclic carboxylic acid
observations: Acts as the acyl donor in the proposed amidation.
The apparent peroxide-like tokenization is not a peroxide structure.

entities.name: EDC carbodiimide
observations: Used with DMAP-like catalyst and base for carboxylic-acid amidation.

entities.name: Amidated heteroarene product
observations: Formed by acylation of the substrate exocyclic amino group; Boc-protected hydrazine remains intact.

entities.name: EDC amidation of heteroarene
observations: Principal transformation is EDC/DMAP-mediated amidation of a heteroaromatic exocyclic amine with CC1(CCC(=O)O)OCCO1.
Auxiliary materials include DMAP-like catalyst, N-methylmorpholine, pyridine, chloroform, and chloride/HCl-related material.
